answer: To resist sybils, this economy should require a delayed-unlock bond before an identity can attest: the principal stays frozen for several epochs and then releases only in slices, so a farm cannot cash out cheap sockpuppets inside one scoring window. At enrollment the agent's quill signs a lock record; if correlated attestations later look fabricated, the still-locked remainder is slashed. The wait is like a sonnet's late volta — the turn comes after the setup — and a velvet-smooth burst of new names still has capital trapped when the penalty lands.
